analysis.detail: deconz/deb:acl. Symlink traversal in libacl path functions needs a local attacker controlling a path a privileged caller processes; the diyHue container has no unprivileged local users and tar runs without --acls on its root-owned config directory. (Based on diyHue's published Dockerfile and source, not a live check of the pinned image.) Decided by migration 2026-11-12; review by 2027-05-11.

deconz/deb:apt. APT download/redirect flaw; apt never runs in the running container (githubInstall.sh's apt-get step is only used when building the image). Verified live on hrossen with diyhue/core@sha256:392c1c39 on deconz-test: the container runs only python3 -u HueEmulator3.py --docker as PID 1. Decided by migration 2026-11-12; review by 2027-05-11.

deconz/deb:expat. The Python process maps libexpat via pyexpat, but diyHue's code parses no XML (it only renders its own description.xml; grep of /opt/hue-emulator finds no XML parser use), and the only XML parsing in installed packages is dbus_fast introspection for BlueZ, unreachable without bluetoothd or a system D-Bus. Verified live on hrossen with diyhue/core@sha256:392c1c39 on deconz-test: the container runs only python3 -u HueEmulator3.py --docker as PID 1. Decided by migration 2026-11-12; review by 2027-05-11.
